title: Multiple Schedule Ii Prescriptions
rule_summary: Federal law permits a practitioner, when all conditions are met, to issue multiple separate Schedule II prescriptions on the actual issue date authorizing a total supply of up to 90 days, with appropriate earliest-fill instructions on later prescriptions rather than postdating or refills.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
